method: Known relocations resolved through compare.results. Actual per-function normalized code plus masks hashed; green status also checks referenced data. Each remote baseline agrees with normal local COFF. All source variants retain every noninclude, nonblank source line exactly, but include definitions/macros can change preprocessed body or ABI: this check is not a preprocessed-equivalence or semantics proof. Context labels describe hypotheses, not proven original include sets. Prior-flat polyinsert/specificfx/bike get current baseline/repeat controls only; their older detailed matrix is build/include-audit. Scores use actual captured objects under local objdump; positional byte errors are not used to rank source parity. No production source edits, flags, compiler binaries, or header changes retained.
frozen_source_observation: Header context demonstrably affects a bounded subset under these tested contexts, but no tested context fixes a red. All eleven pure order/register-stack census candidates remain unchanged. Therefore blanket include rearrangement or CRT flags are not justified. Use source retained-web/stack-identity analysis on that cohort, and keep the ten sensitive reds as a separate finite cohort. These tests do not establish that untested header contexts, C++ mode, type definitions or compiler flags cannot matter.
systemic_conclusion: These measurements are conditional on the currently tuned source bodies. They establish which tested contexts change those fixed bodies, not which context is a better starting point for recovering original code. A context flat on current source can interact with an earlier or alternative source form. No inference that 174 reds are globally header-independent is justified. Joint multi-start source/context search must compare earlier real source forms, optimize within each context, track sibling regressions separately from raw target score, and require existing greens only for retained final changes.

next_experiment.method: Cross current and historical pre-tuning bodies with genuine header contexts, then run the same bounded source operators within each context. Permit intermediate green regressions; retain only fully validated final candidates.
next_experiment.question: Does a context change the source-search outcome even when its frozen current-body score is flat or worse?
